source_text: Regarding the site accessibility, the RE informed the meeting that, as reported during the tripartite meeting on 12 th May 2026, securing a working space within the port is still difficult at present. Nevertheless, the Employer undertook to keep following up withDP World to allocate space to the Contractor once the opportunity is favourable. Subsequently, it was agreed that TPA will arrange with DP World to issue port entry passes well in advance to Contractor's workers to ease entry when the situation will allow to commence works.
